title.vi: Mô hình ngôn ngữ: n-gram, xác suất và perplexity
title.en: Language models: n-grams, probabilities and perplexity

summary.vi: P(từ kế | ngữ cảnh), đếm bigram, làm mượt Laplace, perplexity, từ n-gram đến LLM
summary.en: P(next | context), counting bigrams, Laplace smoothing, perplexity, from n-grams to LLMs

files.name: main.py
files.code:
import numpy as np

from collections import Counter

corpus = "the cat sat on the mat the dog sat on the log".split()
vocab = sorted(set(corpus)); V = len(vocab)
uni = Counter(corpus)
bi = Counter(zip(corpus, corpus[1:]))

def p_bigram(w1, w2, alpha=1.0):
    # xác suất có điều kiện P(w2 | w1) với làm mượt Laplace (cộng alpha)
    return (bi[(w1, w2)] + alpha) / (uni[w1] + alpha * V)

print("P(cat|the) =", round(p_bigram("the", "cat"), 3))
print("P(sat|dog) =", round(p_bigram("dog", "sat"), 3))
print("P(mat|dog) =", round(p_bigram("dog", "mat"), 3), "(chưa từng thấy, nhờ Laplace vẫn > 0)")

def perplexity(sent, alpha=1.0):
    ws = sent.split()
    logp = sum(np.log(p_bigram(a, b, alpha)) for a, b in zip(ws, ws[1:]))
    return float(np.exp(-logp / (len(ws) - 1)))

print("perplexity câu quen :", round(perplexity("the cat sat on the mat"), 2))
print("perplexity câu lạ   :", round(perplexity("mat the on cat sat the"), 2))

prompt.vi: Với corpus 'the cat sat on the mat the dog sat on the log', tính P(cat | the) bằng ước lượng thường (không làm mượt): đếm(the cat)/đếm(the). In kết quả.
prompt.en: With the corpus 'the cat sat on the mat the dog sat on the log', compute P(cat | the) by plain estimation (no smoothing): count(the cat)/count(the). Print the result.

bi = Counter(zip(c, c[1:]))
print(bi[('the', 'cat')] / Counter(c)['the'])

from collections import Counter
c = 'the cat sat on the mat the dog sat on the log'.split()
bi = Counter(zip(c, c[1:])); uni = Counter(c); V = len(set(c))
print(round((bi[('dog', 'mat')] + 1) / (uni['dog'] + V), 4))
